Subject: FinServ — complete removal request for conversational artifacts

Hi Ben,

We're ready to move forward with the removal we discussed last quarter. Per our policy change, FinServ requires a complete purge of all prompt/input texts, generated outputs, and associated service logs (including KV cache snapshots for the customer namespace) for the accounts listed in HS-4721.

Can you confirm Redwood's process, timeline, and what evidence you'll provide once the sweep is completed? We need the proof package for our audit (SOC-ready). Ideal target window is this week or early next week if possible.

Please loop in ops and security contacts on your side.

Thanks,
Alice Wu

FinServ Corp
security@finservcorp.com

Alice — thanks for the note and the form. Looping in Ops (Monica) and Security (Sean) to confirm the plan and timing. High-level:

- Scope: prompts (plain-text inputs), model outputs (generated responses), API request/response logs, and KV cache for the FinServ namespace only.
- Execution window: proposed maintenance window Thu 2026-11-10 02:00–04:00 UTC (low traffic) — Monica, can your team run within that slot?
- Evidence: we deliver a removal_proof PDF summarizing run IDs, operation stamps, checksums, and a runlog excerpt CSV. We can also include an S3 object manifest for the deleted artifacts.

Are there any additional retention holds or legal exceptions we should know about before we proceed?

3) Post-run verification (NOV 10, 03:00–05:00 UTC)
